# External athletics model source

The athletics scoring model is rebuilt from the 2025 scoring-table SQLite
export generated by:

- <https://github.com/jchen1/iaaf-scoring-tables>
- Official table source: <https://worldathletics.org/about-iaaf/documents/technical-information>

Place `iaaf-2025.sqlite` in this directory for local reproducibility, then run:

```bash
python backend/ml/src/build_athletics_scoring_model.py \
  backend/ml/datasets/external/iaaf-2025.sqlite
```

The large source database is intentionally not committed. The generated,
validated regression model is stored in `backend/ml/models/`.
